question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Hasten
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hold**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hasten"** means to move or act quickly, or to accelerate the progress of something. (जल्दी करना, तेज करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She hastened to finish her assignment before the deadline.
 
 
 
• **"Hold" **refers to pausing, restraining, or stopping something from moving forward or progressing. (रोकना, थामना)
 
 
• **Example: **The referee asked the players to hold their positions until the whistle was blown.
 
 
 
• Since "Hold" implies the opposite of moving or acting quickly, it is the most appropriate antonym of "Hasten."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hold**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Urge **(प्रेरित करना): To strongly encourage or persuade someone to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher urged the students to complete their projects on time.
 
 
 
• **Encourage **(प्रोत्साहित करना): To give support or confidence to someone.
 
 
• **Example:** His parents encouraged him to pursue his passion for painting.
 
 
 
• **Serious** (गंभीर): Showing deep thought or sincerity; not playful or joking.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager had a serious discussion about the company's future plans.
